info.title: AMOS API
info.description: API for Analytical Methods & Open Spectra (AMOS). JSON operations require Content-Type: application/json; uploads require multipart/form-data with a real file part. Use POST for searches with request bodies. A browser address-bar request uses GET and cannot invoke a POST operation. Path examples illustrate identifier syntax and do not guarantee that a record exists in the selected deployment. Pagination cursors are opaque tokens returned by the server; omit the cursor for the first page. Metadata PUT operations write data and may clear omitted metadata or substance associations: fetch the editor information and submit the intended complete values. File ingestion performs PDF processing/OCR and indexing synchronously; a client timeout does not prove that an upload failed. Check for the created record before retrying. All error responses use application/problem+json with type, title, status, detail, and request_id. Legacy error/ issues fields are retained for client errors. Every response includes X-Request-ID. Server errors omit internal exception details. Failed requests roll back uncommitted database work; an already committed upload cannot be undone by a later processing failure. Do not automatically retry writes after a timeout or connection loss.
